Summoned via PM:

One of those rare instances when you get a greenlight off the bat. All the ingredients are here: an interesting premise, setting and characters, along with the themes of body horror and sci-fi. You've also outlined the article layout so I know exactly what to expect when reading the final product.

Once you get your second greenlight, do let me know if you want another pass at the draft.

P.S. Just a head's up, Dr Cimmerian had a similar idea recently (just Google 'memory foam cimmerian', but I couldn't find any records of him actually working on the idea or posting the scp. Regardless, you might wanna hustle :p

item.title: [Seeking Greenlights] Memory Foam
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre: Horror

Page Layout: Standard containment procedures, description, details on discovery and interview/test logs

Elevator Pitch: Mattresses used in a care home are found to be altering the memories of residents. They thoroughly enhance dreams and memory consolidation such that upon waking up, recollection of past events allude to the person's dreams. This creates the impression that the affected had their dreams and memories swapped.

The effect is reversible by abstaining from the anomaly. However, frequent use causes the brain to shrink at an accelerating rate; this continues until the brain is depleted of all its mass. The degradation can spread through the skull's orifices, giving the face a sunken appearance. Occasionally, the eyes give way into the cranium especially in those who sleep in the supine position. This can occur before or after death.

Central Narrative: The Foundation acquired multiple instances of the anomaly from a residential care home in [town]. Initially, the facility was monitored when an unusual number of residents began behaving strangely. Because the anomaly's effects are indistinguishable from certain mental and neurological disorders, the exact cause -if there was any- could not be confirmed.

A revised investigation was conducted after deaths began occurring in quick succession. As the victims were of indiscriminate age and health, the root of the anomaly was quickly narrowed down and seized. Detailed examination of the mattresses revealed varying amounts of grey matter in their composition.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: My rendition of a memory-affecting SCP with dreams and body horror.

Additional Notes: I would like to know if this concept is unique enough since memory-affecting is a really common theme.
